  )
  WHERE json_valid(b."manifest")
)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_held_roles" ("workspace", "role") SELECT m."workspace", j."value" FROM "members" m, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(m."roles") THEN m."roles" ELSE '[]' END) j WHERE j."type" = 'text'

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_held_roles" ("workspace", "role") SELECT i."workspace", j."value" FROM "invitations" i, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(i."roles") THEN i."roles" ELSE '[]' END) j WHERE j."type" = 'text'
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_held_roles" ("workspace", "role") SELECT "workspace", "default_role" FROM "membership_settings" WHERE "default_role" IS NOT NULL

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_held_roles" ("workspace", "role") SELECT p."workspace", j."value" FROM "identity_providers" p, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(p."group_roles") THEN p."group_roles" ELSE '{}' END) j WHERE j."type" = 'text'

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_held_roles" ("workspace", "role") SELECT p."workspace", j."value" FROM "saml_providers" p, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(p."group_roles") THEN p."group_roles" ELSE '{}' END) j WHERE j."type" = 'text'

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_role_teams" ("role", "team", "subject")
SELECT DISTINCT "role", NULL, '' FROM "_held_roles"
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_role_teams" ("role", "team", "subject") SELECT DISTINCT "role", NULL, '' FROM (SELECT "role" AS "role" FROM "role_profiles")
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_role_teams" ("role", "team", "subject") SELECT DISTINCT "role", NULL, '' FROM (SELECT "role" AS "role" FROM "role_access")

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_role_teams" ("role", "team", "subject") SELECT DISTINCT "role", NULL, '' FROM (SELECT j."value" AS "role" FROM "tool_availability" a, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(a."subjects") THEN a."subjects" ELSE '[]' END) j WHERE a."mode" = 'roles' AND j."type" = 'text')

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO "_role_teams" ("role", "team", "subject") SELECT DISTINCT "role", NULL, '' FROM (SELECT j."value" AS "role" FROM "channel_access" a, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(a."subjects") THEN a."subjects" ELSE '[]' END) j WHERE a."mode" = 'roles' AND j."type" = 'text')

UPDATE "_role_teams" SET "team" = CASE
  WHEN "role" = 'admin' THEN 'admin'
  WHEN "role" = 'developer' THEN 'developer'
  WHEN "role" = 'member' THEN NULL
  WHEN substr("role", 1, 5) = 'team-' THEN substr("role", 6)
  ELSE substr(lower(replace("role", '_', '-')), 1, 34)
END

UPDATE "_role_teams" SET "team" = "team" || '-team'
WHERE "team" = 'everyone' OR ("team" IN ('admin', 'developer') AND "role" NOT IN ('admin', 'developer') AND substr("role", 1, 5) <> 'team-')
UPDATE "_role_teams" SET "team" = "team" || '-' WHERE length("team") < 2
UPDATE "_role_teams" SET "subject" = CASE WHEN "team" IS NULL THEN 'everyone' ELSE 'team:' || "team" END

SELECT w."workspace", 'developer', p."value" FROM "_workspaces" w,
  json_each('["tools:write","tools:publish","tools:data","access:read","marketplace:read"]') p

SELECT held."workspace", rt."team", held."role", '', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), 0
FROM "_held_roles" held
JOIN "_role_teams" rt ON rt."role" = held."role"
WHERE rt."team" IS NOT NULL AND substr(held."role", 1, 5) <> 'team-'
ORDER BY held."workspace", held."role"

SELECT m."workspace", rt."team", m."id"
FROM "members" m, json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(m."roles") THEN m."roles" ELSE '[]' END) j
JOIN "_role_teams" rt ON rt."role" = j."value"
JOIN "teams" t ON t."workspace" = m."workspace" AND t."id" = rt."team"
WHERE j."type" = 'text' AND rt."team" IS NOT NULL

DELETE FROM "access_grants" WHERE "subject" <> 'everyone' AND "subject" NOT LIKE 'team:%'

UPDATE "tool_availability" SET "mode" = 'everyone', "subjects" = '[]'

UPDATE "channel_access" SET "mode" = 'everyone', "subjects" = '[]'
WHERE "mode" = 'roles' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid("channel_access"."subjects") THEN "channel_access"."subjects" ELSE '[]' END) j WHERE j."value" = 'member')

UPDATE "builds" SET "manifest" = json_remove(json_set("manifest", '$.profiles', json(json_extract("manifest", '$.roles'))), '$.roles')
